coordinateSystem: x increases to the right; y increases upward; both range from 0 to 1
selectionRules: Choose two distinct sensory dimensions from evidence available for this menu category.
Prefer a curated axis pair over inventing axes.
Keep the selected axis set and calibration fixed during filtering, selection and pairing.
Changing axes explicitly creates a new axisSetId or revision and recomputes all placements together.
Unknown placements stay unplaced; never use 0,0 as a substitute for missing information.
